items.title: 1.6 Aakhri nateeje mein kul uncertainty ka andaza (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.6 with Examples 1.1 to 1.3 (PDF 12-14).

blocks.text: Agar hisab mein shamil har factor ki uncertainty maloom ho, to aakhri jawab mein zyada se zyada mumkin uncertainty (error) yun nikalti hai:
1. Jama (addition) aur tafreeq (subtraction) ke liye
Absolute uncertainties jama ki jati hain (tafreeq mein bhi jama hoti hain, kam nahi hotin). Misal: do maqamat x₁ = 15.4 ± 0.1 cm aur x₂ = 25.6 ± 0.1 cm ke darmiyan faasla:
Aur do lambaiyon ℓ₁ = 8.5 ± 0.1 cm aur ℓ₂ = 12.6 ± 0.1 cm ka jor (sum):
Rangeen chhapai (colour printing) sirf chaar rangon, cyan, magenta, yellow aur black, se saare rang banati hai. Is kitab ke sab rang inhi chaar rangon se bane hain.
blocks.title: For your information

blocks.text: 2. Zarb (multiplication) aur taqseem (division) ke liye

Percentage uncertainties jama ki jati hain. Misal: ek conductor ki resistance R us par lagaye gaye potential difference V aur us mein behne wale current I se nikalti hai. R mein zyada se zyada uncertainty yun nikalein:
Farz karein
aur

blocks.text_alt: Percentage uncertainty in V = (0.1 V / 3.4 V) × 100 = 3%
Percentage uncertainty in I = (0.05 A / 0.68 A) × 100 = 7%

blocks.text: Jama aur tafreeq: absolute uncertainties jama karein. Zarb aur taqseem: percentage uncertainties jama karein. Power factor: power × percentage uncertainty.
blocks.title: Thumb Rule for Total Uncertainty

blocks.text: Is liye R ki kul percentage uncertainty 3 + 7 = 10% hai.
R ki qeemat:
10% of 5.0 = 0.5, is liye R = 5.0 ± 0.5 ohm likha jata hai. Uncertainty sirf andaza hai, is liye use ek significant figure tak likhte hain.

blocks.caption: Roshni ke safar ka waqt (For your information)

blocks.text: Kitab Chand se Zameen tak roshni ka waqt 1 min 20 s likhti hai. Chand taqreeban 3.84 × 10⁸ m door hai aur roshni ki speed 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ hai, is liye waqt = 3.84 × 10⁸ / 3 × 10⁸ ≈ 1.3 s hai, ek minute se zyada nahi.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Pluto aur Zameen ka faasla badalta rehta hai, is liye Pluto se roshni aane ka waqt taqreeban 4 se 7 ghante ke darmiyan rehta hai; kitab ka 5 h 20 s ek mota andaza hai.
blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein

blocks.text: 3. Power factor ke liye

Formula mein jis quantity par power lagi ho, us ki percentage uncertainty ko us power se zarb karte hain. Misal: cylinder ka cross-sectional area A = πr² hai; yahan r par power 2 hai, is liye A ki percentage uncertainty = 2 × r ki percentage uncertainty. Power se zarb hone ki wajah se uncertainty barh jati hai, is liye aisi quantity ko zyada precise napna parta hai. Agar ek chhote sphere ka radius 0.01 cm least count wale Vernier Callipers se 1.25 cm napa jaye, to:

blocks.latex: \text{The radius } r \text{ is recorded as}\quad r = 1.25 \pm 0.01\ \text{cm}
blocks.text_alt: The radius r is recorded as r = 1.25 ± 0.01 cm

blocks.latex: \%\text{age uncertainty in radius } r \text{ is}\quad r = \frac{0.01}{1.25} \times 100 = 0.8\%
blocks.text_alt: %age uncertainty in radius r is r = (0.01 / 1.25) × 100 = 0.8%
Total percentage uncertainty in area A = 2 × 0.8 = 1.6%

blocks.text: Is liye nateeja A = 4.91 ± 0.08 cm² likhna chahiye (1.6% of 4.906 ≈ 0.08).
Kitab yahan unit cm likhti hai. Area ka unit square centimetre hai, is liye sahi jawab A = 4.91 ± 0.08 cm² hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
Example 1.1
blocks.problem: Ek dhaat (metal) ki sheet ki lambai 2.03 m, chaurai 1.22 m aur motai 0.95 cm hai. Sheet ka volume munasib significant figures tak nikalein.
steps: V = ℓ × b × h = 2.03 m × 1.22 m × 0.95 × 10⁻² m = 2.35277 × 10⁻² m³ (calculator ka jawab)
Sab se kam significant figures 0.95 mein hain (do), is liye volume do significant figures tak likha jayega.

blocks.title: Example 1.2
blocks.problem: Lever balance se ek dhaat ke dabbe ka mass 3.25 kg napa gaya. Beam balance se nape gaye 10.01 g aur 10.02 g ke do chandi ke sikke us mein dale gaye. Ab dabbe ka kul mass munasib precision tak kya hai?
steps: Grams ko kg mein badlein: 10.01 g = 0.01001 kg, 10.02 g = 0.01002 kg
Sab se kam precise mass 3.25 kg hai (do decimal places), is liye jama ka jawab bhi do decimal places tak.

blocks.title: Example 1.3
blocks.problem: 0.01 cm least count wale Vernier Callipers se ek dhaat ke cylinder ka diameter 1.25 cm aur lambai 3.35 cm napi gayi. Cylinder ka volume V aur us ki uncertainty nikalein.
steps: Lambai ki absolute uncertainty = 0.01 cm; percentage = (0.01 / 3.35) × 100 ≈ 0.3%
Diameter ki absolute uncertainty = 0.01 cm; percentage = (0.01 / 1.25) × 100 = 0.8%
V = πr²ℓ = π(d²/4)ℓ; d par power 2 hai, is liye V ki uncertainty = 2 × 0.8 + 0.3 = 1.9%

blocks.prompt: Pendulum ka time period T = 2.00 ± 0.01 s aur lambai ℓ = 99.5 ± 0.1 cm napi gayi. g = 4π²ℓ/T² se nikale gaye g mein percentage uncertainty kitni hogi?
blocks.explanation: ℓ ki percentage uncertainty = (0.1 / 99.5) × 100 ≈ 0.1%. T ki = (0.01 / 2.00) × 100 = 0.5%; T par power 2 hai, is liye us ka hissa 2 × 0.5 = 1.0%. Taqseem mein percentage uncertainties jama hoti hain: kul ≈ 0.1 + 1.0 = 1.1% ≈ 1%. g = 4 × 9.87 × 0.995 / 4.00 ≈ 9.82 m s⁻², jo 9.8 ± 0.1 m s⁻² likha jayega.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Jama ya tafreeq: absolute uncertainties jama (x = 10.2 ± 0.2 cm).
Zarb ya taqseem: percentage uncertainties jama (3% + 7% = 10%, R = 5.0 ± 0.5 ohm).
Power: percentage uncertainty × power (A = πr²: 2 × 0.8% = 1.6%, A = 4.91 ± 0.08 cm²).
Misalein: V = 2.4 × 10⁻² m³; kul mass 3.27 kg; cylinder V = (4.11 ± 0.08) cm³.
